Nothing has cleared yet. The leaderboard still reports how far short every route falls — that shortfall is the measurement.
Paper mode. No private key is loaded and no transaction is ever signed. Live execution needs mode = "live" in config.toml and CRYPTOBOT_ALLOW_LIVE=1, and is deliberately not implemented.
Every price here is decoded from mainnet accounts. Concentrated-liquidity pools are quoted through their virtual reserves and refuse to price a trade larger than the current tick can hold, so a route's depth is a real limit rather than an extrapolation. Decoders are audited against an independent router with cb-bot --verify.
Opportunities counts distinct episodes, not detections: a gap that stands still is re-seen every sweep, and counting each sighting as a trade inflates the total by orders of magnitude.
